name: Universalist churches

facts.value: 1779, first American congregation at Gloucester, Massachusetts

citations.excerpt: in 1779 formed with fifteen other persons the first American congregation of that faith at Gloucester, Massachusetts .
The stronghold of the sect is in America, where the first church was established by Rev. John Murray.

facts.value: Belief in the final salvation of all souls. Winchester Profession 1803.

citations.excerpt: whose distinctive tenet is the belief in the final salvation of all souls .
The historic creed of this religious body is the profession of belief adopted by the General Convention at Winchester , New Hampshire , in 1803.

facts.value: 1961, merged into the Unitarian Universalist Association

citations.excerpt: The Unitarian Universalist Association was formed in 1961 by the merger of the American Unitarian Association and the Universalist Church in America.
